hrmsKiosk.title: Attendance kiosk
hrmsKiosk.cantReach: Can’t reach the server. Check the tablet’s connection.

setup.title: Set up this kiosk
setup.hint: Paste the kiosk key from Staff & HR › Attendance › Setup › Kiosks. The tablet remembers it.

punch.title: Mark your attendance
punch.hint: Your employee code and your kiosk PIN. In or out is worked out from your duty.
punch.noPin: No PIN yet? Set one in My workspace › Account & security.

unpair.title: Unpair this kiosk
unpair.hint: Enter this kiosk’s key to remove it from this tablet. Staff can’t punch here until a key is entered again.
unpair.wrongKey: That isn’t this kiosk’s key. Ask HR — they can reissue it from Attendance › Setup › Kiosks.

scan.title: Scan your ID card
scan.hint: Hold the QR code or barcode on your staff ID card up to the camera.
scan.cardScanned: ID card scanned — now enter your PIN
scan.notACard: That isn’t a staff ID card. Try again, or type your employee code.
